proposed_rules.trigger: A component (untagged container, likely an image carousel/gallery) is rendered directly above its descriptive heading/paragraph, reversing the usual heading-then-component order.
proposed_rules.decision: Still map the heading/paragraph as default-content and the component as its own block within the same section; do not reorder content authoring purely to match the generic rule's example order, since EDS markdown order should mirror DOM order.
proposed_rules.rationale: The generic heading-then-component-same-section rule assumes heading precedes component; here the DOM order is reversed. Alternative rejected: forcing heading-first authoring order to match the generic rule literally, which would misrepresent actual page flow and confuse content reviewers.
